internal_odh.purpose: Reconcile HTTPRoute resources against a configured Gateway

external_connections.name: AuthConfig
external_connections.doc: AuthConfig defines the authentication method for an ExternalProvider.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc: Type identifies the auth type for this provider. e.g. "apikey" (header based), "sigv4", etc.

fields.name: SecretRef
fields.doc: SecretRef references a Kubernetes Secret containing the provider API key. The Secret must be in the same namespace as the ExternalProvider and must contain a data key "api-key" with the credential value.

external_connections.name: NameReference
external_connections.doc: NameReference is a reference to a Kubernetes resource by name. The referenced resource must be in the same namespace.

external_connections.name: ExternalModelStatus
external_connections.doc: ExternalModelStatus defines the observed state of ExternalModel.

fields.name: Phase
fields.doc: Phase represents the current reconciliation phase. Ready: all networking resources created successfully. Failed: reconciliation error (e.g., missing ExternalProvider, missing Secret). This reflects controller reconciliation state, not runtime request health.

fields.name: HTTPRouteName
fields.doc: HTTPRouteName is the name of the HTTPRoute created by the controller for this ExternalModel. Consumers (e.g., maas-controller) can read this to attach policies without assuming naming conventions.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.doc: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the model's state.

external_connections.name: ExternalModelList
external_connections.doc: ExternalModelList contains a list of ExternalModel.

external_connections.name: ExternalModel
external_connections.doc: ExternalModel defines a client-facing model that maps to one or more external providers. The model name clients use in requests is determined by spec.modelName (if set) or metadata.name (default).

external_connections.name: ExternalModelSpec
external_connections.doc: ExternalModelSpec defines the desired state of ExternalModel.

fields.name: ModelName
fields.doc: ModelName is the client-facing model name used in inference request bodies. Clients send this value in the "model" field of chat completion requests. Defaults to metadata.name if not set. Use this field when the desired model name contains characters not allowed in Kubernetes resource names (dots, colons, slashes, uppercase).

fields.name: ExternalProviderRefs
fields.doc: ExternalProviderRefs maps this model to one or more external providers. Each entry specifies the provider specific details.

external_connections.name: ExternalProviderRef
external_connections.doc: ExternalProviderRef binds this model to a specific provider with translation config.

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: Ref identifies the ExternalProvider CR (must be in the same namespace).

fields.name: TargetModel
fields.doc: TargetModel is the provider-specific model identifier. e.g. "gpt-4o", "anthropic.claude-3-opus", "claude-sonnet-4-5-20241022".

fields.name: APIFormat
fields.doc: APIFormat determines how requests/responses are translated for this provider. Supported values: - "openai-chat": OpenAI Chat Completions API (/v1/chat/completions) - "messages": Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages)

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: Path sets the outgoing request `:path` pseudo-header for this model-provider binding. Must be a valid absolute path (e.g. "/v1/chat/completions" or "/maas-default-gateway/v1/chat/completions"). Supports {key} placeholders resolved from the merged Config map.

fields.name: Config
fields.doc: Config holds model-specific configuration as key-value pairs. Overrides the ExternalProvider config for this model-provider binding.

fields.name: Auth
fields.doc: Auth overrides the ExternalProvider authentication for this model-provider binding. If not set, the ExternalProvider auth is used.

fields.name: Weight
fields.doc: Weight determines the relative traffic proportion for this provider binding. Higher weight means more traffic. Used for weighted random selection across multiple provider refs. A weight of 0 disables the ref (no traffic routed to it). Defaults to 1 if not set.

external_connections.name: ExternalProvider
external_connections.doc: ExternalProvider defines a connection to an external LLM provider (endpoint + credentials). Multiple ExternalModel resources can reference the same ExternalProvider.

external_connections.name: ExternalProviderSpec
external_connections.doc: ExternalProviderSpec defines the desired state of ExternalProvider.

fields.name: Provider
fields.doc: Provider identifies the API type for this provider. e.g. "openai", "anthropic", "azure", "aws-bedrock", "vertex".

fields.name: Endpoint
fields.doc: Endpoint is the FQDN of the external provider (no scheme or path). e.g. "api.openai.com", "bedrock.amazonaws.com".

fields.name: Auth
fields.doc: Auth configures how to authenticate with the provider.

fields.name: Config
fields.doc: Config holds provider-specific configuration as key-value pairs. e.g., Vertex AI: {"project": "my-project", "location": "us-central1"}.

external_connections.name: ExternalProviderStatus
external_connections.doc: ExternalProviderStatus defines the observed state of ExternalProvider.

fields.name: Phase
fields.doc: Phase represents the current reconciliation phase. Ready: all networking resources created and Secret validated. Failed: reconciliation error (e.g., missing Secret, Istio resource creation failed). This reflects controller reconciliation state, not runtime request health.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.doc: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the provider's state.

external_connections.name: ExternalProviderList
external_connections.doc: ExternalProviderList contains a list of ExternalProvider.

operator_config.name: anthropicBetaHeader
operator_config.doc:
anthropicBetaHeader carries client-requested Anthropic beta features.
Vertex AI rejects the whole request (400) when the header contains any
beta flag it does not recognize, so vertex translators strip the header.

operator_config.name: vertexUnsupportedBodyFields
operator_config.doc:
vertexUnsupportedBodyFields are Anthropic Messages API request fields that Vertex AI's
Claude endpoint rejects with 400 "Extra inputs are not permitted". Clients such as
Claude Code send them; the corresponding features degrade gracefully when dropped.

operator_config.doc: tokenFetchTimeout limits how long we wait for Google's token endpoint.

operator_config.name: maxErrorMessageLen
operator_config.doc:
maxErrorMessageLen caps the provider error text persisted to metering:
error bodies can be long and may echo request content, neither of which
belongs in the metering store.

operator_config.name: meteringChunkBufferKey
operator_config.doc:
meteringChunkBufferKey holds the raw response body accumulated across chunks,
used to recover usage from payloads split across Envoy chunk boundaries.

operator_config.name: MaaSHeadersKey
operator_config.doc:
MaaSHeadersKey is the CycleState key where captured x-maas-* headers are stored
as a map[string]string. Downstream plugins read from this instead of request headers.

operator_config.name: defaultAuthHeaders
operator_config.doc:
defaultAuthHeaders maps providers that use a non-standard auth header name.
Providers not listed here fall back to "Authorization" with "Bearer " prefix
in the auth generator.

operator_config.name: SelectedProviderHeader
operator_config.doc:
SelectedProviderHeader is set by the plugin on each request to drive
Envoy routing. The HTTPRoute reconciler creates per-provider route rules
that match on this header, ensuring the destination and credential are
always consistent.

operator_config.name: NemoRequestGuardPluginType
operator_config.doc: NemoRequestGuardPluginType is the plugin type identifier.
